name: Tool approval executing → awaiting_approval
description: Gate facts are append-only JSON string pairs [loopID,executionID]. Answers reconcile both pending and answered in one revision-fenced run mutation, so answered is a subset of pending. The same mutation derives approval-outstanding; duplicate tuples do not inflate it. An unanswered observed gate pauses an executing run. The reserved reason, source=rule and from=executing identify this pause atomically in lifecycle audit triples.
